## About
Car Tech Collision Center is a family owned and operated auto body shop on Main Street in Rowlett. We repair cars for folks in Rowlett, Rockwall, Sachse, Mesquite, Plano, Heath, Royse City, Garland and the surrounding areas.
Our certified I-Car technicians handle collision repair, paint, dents and hail damage. We match OEM finishes on domestic vehicles, European cars and other imports, and we can help with new and vintage vehicles too. We work with the general public and with businesses that run fleet vehicles.
We will deal with any insurance company, keep your car in a safe gated area or garage, and offer free towing, free pick up and delivery, and car rental assistance. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 82 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto body repairs and paint: Body repairs and paint work for your vehicle.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent removal designed to get your vehicle looking its best.
- Hail damage repairs: Repairs for hail damage.
- Fleet collision and refinishing: Collision and refinishing work for businesses with fleet vehicles.
- Auto glass

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We will deal with any insurance company.

Q: Is my car safe while it's at your shop?
A: Yes. We keep vehicles in a safe gated area, and we have garage storage as well.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Rowlett, Rockwall, Sachse, Mesquite, Plano, Heath, Royse City, Garland and the surrounding areas.

Q: What are your Saturday hours?
A: On Saturday we're open from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m.
